description:
Get subjectRightsRequests from security

TIP: Lists data subject rights requests (DSAR) for privacy compliance. Each has displayName, type (access, delete, export, tagForAction), status (active, closed), dataSubjectType, createdDateTime, createdBy, stages, and regulation. Used for GDPR/privacy compliance.

RISK LEVEL: HIGH. This response contains secrets or highly sensitive data (e.g. recovery keys, LAPS passwords, legal-hold material). Do not echo verbatim; confirm with the operator before sharing.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.
